novelty_points.claim: 提出了一种基于图摘要的大规模时序图表示学习方法GSAERU，该方法将动态时序图建模为各时刻的图快照序列，利用图摘要技术压缩原图后输入图自编码器学习节点表征，再通过循环神经网络捕获时间维度上的特征依赖，从而高效生成大规模时序图的低维表征。
novelty_points.claim_en: Proposed a large-scale sequential graph representation learning method GSAERU based on graph summarization, which models dynamic sequential graphs as a sequence of graph snapshots, uses graph summarization to compress the original graph and feeds it into a graph autoencoder to learn node representations, then employs a recurrent neural network to capture temporal dependencies, thereby efficiently generating low-dimensional representations of large-scale sequential graphs.
technical_features: 通过图摘要技术对原始大规模图进行压缩，降低后续处理复杂度
利用图自编码器重构原图来训练节点表征，保证表征质量
引入循环神经网络学习不同时间步上表征的时间依赖关系
technical_features_en: Compresses the original large-scale graph using graph summarization to reduce downstream processing complexity
Trains node representations using a graph autoencoder with reconstruction loss against the original graph
Employs a recurrent neural network to learn temporal dependencies of representations across time steps
